# Repository

class Repository:
    """Owns the sqlite connection. Domain methods go through the model
    classes; this layer is just CRUD for them."""

    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection):
        self.conn = conn

    # --- generic helpers ------------------------------------------------

    def commit(self):
        self.conn.commit()

    # --- section CRUD ---------------------------------------------------

    def insert_section(self, key: str, position: int, section_type: str,
                       heading: str | None,
                       layer_code: str | None, branch_code: str | None):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sections(key, position, section_type, heading, "
            "layer_code, branch_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (key, position, section_type, heading, layer_code, branch_code),
        )

    def get_section_row(self, key: str):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT key, position, section_type, heading, layer_code, branch_code "
            "FROM sections WHERE key=?", (key,)
        ).fetchone()

    def update_section_heading(self, key: str, heading: str):
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE sections SET heading=? WHERE key=?",
                          (heading, key))

    def all_section_rows(self):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT key, position, section_type, heading, layer_code, branch_code "
            "FROM sections ORDER BY position"
        ).fetchall()

    # --- section_parts --------------------------------------------------

    def insert_section_part(self, section_key: str, position: int,
                            kind: str, prose: str | None,
                            vendor_block_id: int | None) -> int:
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO section_parts(section_key, position, kind, prose, "
            "vendor_block_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (section_key, position, kind, prose, vendor_block_id),
        )
        return cur.lastrowid

    def section_parts(self, section_key: str):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, position, kind, prose, vendor_block_id "
            "FROM section_parts WHERE section_key=? ORDER BY position",
            (section_key,),
        ).fetchall()

    def update_section_part_prose(self, part_id: int, prose: str):
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE section_parts SET prose=? WHERE id=?",
                          (prose, part_id))

    # --- vendor_blocks --------------------------------------------------

    def insert_vendor_block(self, vb: VendorBlock) -> int:
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO vendor_blocks(section_key, label, vendor, label_form, "
            "layout, separator, head_prose, tail_prose, bullet_indent) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (vb.section_key, vb.label, vb.vendor, vb.label_form,
             vb.layout, vb.separator, vb.head_prose, vb.tail_prose,
             vb.bullet_indent),
        )
        vb.id = cur.lastrowid
        return vb.id

    def update_vendor_block(self, vb: VendorBlock):
        self.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE vendor_blocks SET label=?, vendor=?, label_form=?, "
            "layout=?, separator=?, head_prose=?, tail_prose=?, "
            "bullet_indent=? WHERE id=?",
            (vb.label, vb.vendor, vb.label_form, vb.layout, vb.separator,
             vb.head_prose, vb.tail_prose, vb.bullet_indent, vb.id),
        )

    def load_vendor_block(self, vb_id: int) -> VendorBlock | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, section_key, label, vendor, label_form, layout, "
            "separator, head_prose, tail_prose, bullet_indent "
            "FROM vendor_blocks WHERE id=?", (vb_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return None
        vb = VendorBlock(
            id=row[0], section_key=row[1], label=row[2], vendor=row[3],
            label_form=row[4], layout=row[5], separator=row[6],
            head_prose=row[7], tail_prose=row[8], bullet_indent=row[9],
        )
        vb.entries = self.load_entries_for_vb(vb_id)
        return vb

    def vendor_blocks_for_section(self, section_key: str) -> list[VendorBlock]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM vendor_blocks WHERE section_key=?",
            (section_key,)
        ).fetchall()
        return [self.load_vendor_block(r[0]) for r in rows]

    def find_vendor_block_by_label(self, section_key: str,
                                   label: str) -> VendorBlock | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM vendor_blocks WHERE section_key=? AND label=?",
            (section_key, label)
        ).fetchone()
        return self.load_vendor_block(row[0]) if row else None

    # --- entries --------------------------------------------------------

    def insert_entry(self, e: Entry) -> int:
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO entries(slug, name, url, notes, bold, "
            "vendor_block_id, position, section_key, layer_code, "
            "branch_code, vendor, category) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (e.slug, e.name, e.url, e.notes, int(e.bold),
             e.vendor_block_id, e.position, e.section_key,
             e.layer_code, e.branch_code, e.vendor, e.category),
        )
        e.id = cur.lastrowid
        for pos, rn in enumerate(e.ref_nums):
            self.conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO entry_refs(entry_id, ref_num, position) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (e.id, rn, pos),
            )
        return e.id

    def update_entry(self, e: Entry):
        self.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE entries SET name=?, url=?, notes=?, bold=?, "
            "vendor=?, category=? WHERE id=?",
            (e.name, e.url, e.notes, int(e.bold), e.vendor, e.category, e.id),
        )

    def load_entry(self, slug: str = None, entry_id: int = None) -> Entry | None:
        if slug is not None:
            row = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, slug, name, url, notes, bold, vendor_block_id, "
                "position, section_key, layer_code, branch_code, vendor, "
                "category FROM entries WHERE slug=?", (slug,)
            ).fetchone()
        else:
            row = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, slug, name, url, notes, bold, vendor_block_id, "
                "position, section_key, layer_code, branch_code, vendor, "
                "category FROM entries WHERE id=?", (entry_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return None
        e = Entry(
            id=row[0], slug=row[1], name=row[2], url=row[3], notes=row[4],
            bold=bool(row[5]), vendor_block_id=row[6], position=row[7],
            section_key=row[8], layer_code=row[9], branch_code=row[10],
            vendor=row[11], category=row[12],
        )
        e.ref_nums = self.refs_for_entry(e.id)
        return e

    def load_entries_for_vb(self, vb_id: int) -> list[Entry]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, slug, name, url, notes, bold, vendor_block_id, "
            "position, section_key, layer_code, branch_code, vendor, "
            "category FROM entries WHERE vendor_block_id=? ORDER BY position",
            (vb_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        out = []
        for row in rows:
            e = Entry(
                id=row[0], slug=row[1], name=row[2], url=row[3], notes=row[4],
                bold=bool(row[5]), vendor_block_id=row[6], position=row[7],
                section_key=row[8], layer_code=row[9], branch_code=row[10],
                vendor=row[11], category=row[12],
            )
            e.ref_nums = self.refs_for_entry(e.id)
            out.append(e)
        return out

    def refs_for_entry(self, entry_id: int) -> list[int]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT ref_num FROM entry_refs WHERE entry_id=? ORDER BY position",
            (entry_id,)
        ).fetchall()
        return [r[0] for r in rows]

    def delete_entry(self, entry_id: int):
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM entries WHERE id=?", (entry_id,))

    def reposition_entries(self, vb_id: int):
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM entries WHERE vendor_block_id=? ORDER BY position, id",
            (vb_id,)
        ).fetchall()
        for i, (eid,) in enumerate(rows):
            self.conn.execute("UPDATE entries SET position=? WHERE id=?",
                              (i, eid))

    def set_entry_refs(self, entry_id: int, ref_nums: list[int]):
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM entry_refs WHERE entry_id=?", (entry_id,))
        for pos, rn in enumerate(ref_nums):
            self.conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO entry_refs(entry_id, ref_num, position) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (entry_id, rn, pos),
            )

    # --- refs -----------------------------------------------------------

    def insert_ref(self, num: int, citation: str, url: str | None):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO refs(num, citation, url) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (num, citation, url),
        )

    def update_ref(self, num: int, citation: str | None, url: str | None):
        fields, vals = [], []
        if citation is not None:
            fields.append("citation=?"); vals.append(citation)
        if url is not None:
            fields.append("url=?"); vals.append(url)
        if not fields:
            return
        vals.append(num)
        self.conn.execute(
            f"UPDATE refs SET {', '.join(fields)} WHERE num=?", vals,
        )

    def load_ref(self, num: int) -> Ref | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT num, citation, url FROM refs WHERE num=?", (num,)
        ).fetchone()
        return Ref(num=row[0], citation=row[1], url=row[2]) if row else None

    def all_refs(self) -> list[Ref]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT num, citation, url FROM refs ORDER BY num"
        ).fetchall()
        return [Ref(num=r[0], citation=r[1], url=r[2]) for r in rows]

    def max_ref(self) -> int:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(num), 0) FROM refs"
        ).fetchone()
        return row[0]

    def find_ref_by_url(self, url: str) -> int | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT num FROM refs WHERE url=?", (url,)
        ).fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None

    def delete_ref(self, num: int):
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM refs WHERE num=?", (num,))

    # --- cells ----------------------------------------------------------

    def insert_cell(self, layer_code: str, branch_code: str,
                    text: str | None, marker: str):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cells(layer_code, branch_code, text, marker) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (layer_code, branch_code, text, marker),
        )

    def get_cell(self, layer_code: str, branch_code: str):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT text, marker FROM cells WHERE layer_code=? AND branch_code=?",
            (layer_code, branch_code)
        ).fetchone()

    def all_cells_for_layer(self, layer_code: str) -> list[tuple]:
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT branch_code, text, marker FROM cells WHERE layer_code=?",
            (layer_code,)
        ).fetchall()

    # --- layers / branches ---------------------------------------------

    def insert_layer(self, code: str, position: int, name: str):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO layers(code, position, name) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (code, position, name),
        )

    def insert_branch(self, code: str, parent_code: str | None,
                      position: int, name: str):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO branches(code, parent_code, position, name) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (code, parent_code, position, name),
        )

    def all_layers(self):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT code, position, name FROM layers ORDER BY position"
        ).fetchall()

# Section classes

@dataclass
class SectionPart:
    id: int
    position: int
    kind: str                       # 'prose' | 'vendor_block' | 'summary_table' | 'refs_list'
    prose: str | None
    vendor_block: VendorBlock | None

    def render(self, doc: "Document") -> str:
        if self.kind == "prose":
            return self.prose or ""
        if self.kind == "vendor_block":
            return self.vendor_block.render() if self.vendor_block else ""
        if self.kind == "summary_table":
            return doc._render_summary_table()
        if self.kind == "refs_list":
            return doc._render_refs_list()
        raise ValueError(f"unknown section_part kind: {self.kind}")


class Section:
    """Base class. Concrete subclasses customize render shape."""

    section_type: str = "other"

    def __init__(self, doc: "Document", key: str, position: int,
                 heading: str | None, layer_code: str | None,
                 branch_code: str | None):
        self.doc = doc
        self.repo = doc.repo
        self.key = key
        self.position = position
        self.heading = heading
        self.layer_code = layer_code
        self.branch_code = branch_code
        self._parts: list[SectionPart] | None = None

    # ----- common -------------------------------------------------------

    def parts(self) -> list[SectionPart]:
        if self._parts is None:
            rows = self.repo.section_parts(self.key)
            out: list[SectionPart] = []
            for r in rows:
                part_id, position, kind, prose, vb_id = r
                vb = self.repo.load_vendor_block(vb_id) if vb_id else None
                out.append(SectionPart(
                    id=part_id, position=position, kind=kind,
                    prose=prose, vendor_block=vb,
                ))
            self._parts = out
        return self._parts

    def reload(self):
        self._parts = None

    def set_heading(self, heading: str):
        self.heading = heading
        self.repo.update_section_heading(self.key, heading)

    def render(self) -> str:
        body = self._render_body()
        if self.section_type == "doc_top":
            return body
        prefix = "###" if self.section_type in ("branch", "subbranch") else "##"
        return f"\n\n{prefix} {self.heading}\n\n{body}"

    def _render_body(self) -> str:
        pieces: list[str] = []
        last_kind: str | None = None
        for p in self.parts():
            txt = p.render(self.doc)
            if not txt:
                continue
            if pieces:
                pieces.append("\n\n")
            pieces.append(txt)
            last_kind = p.kind
        return "".join(pieces)


class _ProseOnly(Section):
    """For sections whose body is a single prose blob."""

    def get_body(self) -> str:
        parts = self.parts()
        return parts[0].prose if parts else ""

    def set_body(self, body: str):
        parts = self.parts()
        if not parts:
            pid = self.repo.insert_section_part(self.key, 0, "prose", body, None)
            self._parts = None
            return
        # update the first prose part; delete extras
        first = parts[0]
        self.repo.update_section_part_prose(first.id, body)
        for extra in parts[1:]:
            self.repo.conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM section_parts WHERE id=?", (extra.id,)
            )
        self._parts = None


class DocTop(_ProseOnly):
    section_type = "doc_top"


class MainOverview(_ProseOnly):
    section_type = "main_overview"


class BranchIntro(_ProseOnly):
    section_type = "branch_intro"


class Branch(_ProseOnly):
    section_type = "branch"


class Crosscut(_ProseOnly):
    section_type = "crosscut"


class Other(_ProseOnly):
    section_type = "other"


class _LayerOrSub(Section):
    """Layer / SubBranch sections — interleaved prose and vendor_blocks."""

    def vendor_blocks(self) -> list[VendorBlock]:
        return [p.vendor_block for p in self.parts() if p.kind == "vendor_block"]

    def vendor_block(self, label: str) -> VendorBlock | None:
        return self.repo.find_vendor_block_by_label(self.key, label)

    def find_entry(self, slug: str) -> Entry | None:
        e = self.repo.load_entry(slug=slug)
        if e and e.section_key == self.key:
            return e
        return None

    def set_intro(self, text: str):
        """Replace the first prose part."""
        for p in self.parts():
            if p.kind == "prose":
                self.repo.update_section_part_prose(p.id, text)
                self._parts = None
                return
        raise ValueError(f"section {self.key} has no prose intro part to set")

    def set_outro(self, text: str):
        """Replace the last prose part. Create one if absent."""
        parts = self.parts()
        prose_parts = [p for p in parts if p.kind == "prose"]
        if len(prose_parts) >= 2:
            self.repo.update_section_part_prose(prose_parts[-1].id, text)
            self._parts = None
            return
        # else: append a new prose part at the end
        next_pos = max((p.position for p in parts), default=-1) + 1
        self.repo.insert_section_part(self.key, next_pos, "prose", text, None)
        self._parts = None

    def add_vendor_block(self, label: str | None, layout: str = "inline",
                         label_form: str = "standalone",
                         separator: str | None = None,
                         position: int | None = None,
                         bullet_indent: str | None = None) -> VendorBlock:
        vb = VendorBlock(
            id=0, section_key=self.key,
            label=label, vendor=canonical_vendor(label or "") if label else None,
            label_form=label_form, layout=layout, separator=separator,
            head_prose=None, tail_prose=None, bullet_indent=bullet_indent,
        )
        self.repo.insert_vendor_block(vb)
        # append as a new section_part at end (or at given position)
        parts = self.parts()
        if position is None:
            pos = max((p.position for p in parts), default=-1) + 1
        else:
            pos = position
            self.repo.conn.execute(
                "UPDATE section_parts SET position = position + 1 "
                "WHERE section_key=? AND position >= ?", (self.key, pos),
            )
        self.repo.insert_section_part(self.key, pos, "vendor_block",
                                      None, vb.id)
        self._parts = None
        return vb

    def remove_vendor_block(self, label: str):
        vb = self.vendor_block(label)
        if not vb:
            raise ValueError(f"vendor_block '{label}' not in section {self.key}")
        self.repo.conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM section_parts WHERE vendor_block_id=?", (vb.id,)
        )
        self.repo.conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM vendor_blocks WHERE id=?", (vb.id,)
        )
        self._parts = None


class Layer(_LayerOrSub):
    section_type = "layer"


class SubBranch(_LayerOrSub):
    section_type = "subbranch"


class SummaryTable(Section):
    section_type = "summary_table"

    def get_intro(self) -> str:
        for p in self.parts():
            if p.kind == "prose":
                return p.prose or ""
        return ""

    def set_intro(self, text: str):
        for p in self.parts():
            if p.kind == "prose":
                self.repo.update_section_part_prose(p.id, text)
                self._parts = None
                return
        # no prose part — insert at position 0 and shift
        self.repo.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE section_parts SET position = position + 1 "
            "WHERE section_key=?", (self.key,)
        )
        self.repo.insert_section_part(self.key, 0, "prose", text, None)
        self._parts = None

    def get_cell(self, layer_code: str, branch_code: str) -> str | None:
        row = self.repo.get_cell(layer_code, branch_code)
        return row[0] if row else None

    def set_cell(self, layer_code: str, branch_code: str, text: str | None):
        marker = classify_cell_marker(text or "")
        self.repo.insert_cell(layer_code, branch_code, text, marker)


class Refs(Section):
    section_type = "refs"

    def get_intro(self) -> str:
        for p in self.parts():
            if p.kind == "prose":
                return p.prose or ""
        return ""

    def set_intro(self, text: str):
        for p in self.parts():
            if p.kind == "prose":
                self.repo.update_section_part_prose(p.id, text)
                self._parts = None
                return
        self.repo.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE section_parts SET position = position + 1 "
            "WHERE section_key=?", (self.key,)
        )
        self.repo.insert_section_part(self.key, 0, "prose", text, None)
        self._parts = None

    def next_num(self) -> int:
        return self.repo.max_ref() + 1

    def add(self, citation: str, url: str | None = None) -> int:
        num = self.next_num()
        self.repo.insert_ref(num, citation, url)
        return num

    def get(self, num: int) -> Ref | None:
        return self.repo.load_ref(num)

    def set(self, num: int, citation: str | None = None, url: str | None = None):
        self.repo.update_ref(num, citation, url)

    def remove(self, num: int):
        self.repo.delete_ref(num)

}

# Document

class Document:
    """Top-level View template. Owns the section list and exposes the public
    mutation API. All section-finding goes through `section(key)`; no string
    lookup in body."""

    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection):
        self.repo = Repository(conn)
        self._cache: dict[str, Section] = {}

    # --- section access -------------------------------------------------

    def section(self, key: str) -> Section:
        if key in self._cache:
            return self._cache[key]
        row = self.repo.get_section_row(key)
        if not row:
            raise KeyError(f"section '{key}' not found")
        section = self._instantiate(row)
        self._cache[key] = section
        return section

    def sections(self) -> Iterable[Section]:
        for row in self.repo.all_section_rows():
            key = row[0]
            if key not in self._cache:
                self._cache[key] = self._instantiate(row)
            yield self._cache[key]

    def _instantiate(self, row) -> Section:
        key, position, stype, heading, layer_code, branch_code = row
        cls = SECTION_CLASSES.get(stype, Other)
        return cls(self, key=key, position=position, heading=heading,
                   layer_code=layer_code, branch_code=branch_code)

    # --- entry by slug --------------------------------------------------

    def entry(self, slug: str) -> Entry | None:
        return self.repo.load_entry(slug=slug)

    def ref(self, num: int) -> Ref | None:
        return self.repo.load_ref(num)

    # --- entry mutations ------------------------------------------------

    def set_entry_url(self, slug: str, url: str):
        e = self.entry(slug)
        if not e:
            raise KeyError(f"entry '{slug}' not found")
        e.url = url
        self.repo.update_entry(e)

    def set_entry_name(self, slug: str, name: str):
        e = self.entry(slug)
        if not e:
            raise KeyError(f"entry '{slug}' not found")
        e.name = name
        self.repo.update_entry(e)

    def set_entry_notes(self, slug: str, notes: str | None):
        e = self.entry(slug)
        if not e:
            raise KeyError(f"entry '{slug}' not found")
        e.notes = notes
        self.repo.update_entry(e)

    def add_entry_ref(self, slug: str, num: int):
        e = self.entry(slug)
        if not e:
            raise KeyError(f"entry '{slug}' not found")
        if num in e.ref_nums:
            return
        e.ref_nums.append(num)
        self.repo.set_entry_refs(e.id, e.ref_nums)

    def remove_entry_ref(self, slug: str, num: int):
        e = self.entry(slug)
        if not e or num not in e.ref_nums:
            return
        e.ref_nums.remove(num)
        self.repo.set_entry_refs(e.id, e.ref_nums)

    def add_entry(self, section_key: str, vb_label: str | None,
                  name: str, url: str, ref_num: int,
                  notes: str | None = None, bold: bool = False,
                  position: int | None = None) -> Entry:
        section = self.section(section_key)
        if not isinstance(section, _LayerOrSub):
            raise TypeError(f"section '{section_key}' is not a Layer/SubBranch")
        if vb_label is None:
            vb = None
            # find unlabeled (label IS NULL) vendor_block in section
            row = self.repo.conn.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM vendor_blocks WHERE section_key=? AND label IS NULL",
                (section_key,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row:
                vb = self.repo.load_vendor_block(row[0])
        else:
            vb = section.vendor_block(vb_label)
        if vb is None:
            raise KeyError(
                f"vendor_block label='{vb_label}' not in section '{section_key}'. "
                f"Add it first via `vb add`.")
        # determine slug prefix
        slug_prefix = section.layer_code or section.branch_code or section_key
        slug = slugify(slug_prefix, name)
        # ensure unique
        n = 2
        base = slug
        while self.repo.load_entry(slug=slug):
            slug = f"{base}-{n}"; n += 1
        # determine position
        existing = self.repo.load_entries_for_vb(vb.id)
        if position is None:
            position = len(existing)
        else:
            for e in existing:
                if e.position >= position:
                    self.repo.conn.execute(
                        "UPDATE entries SET position = position + 1 WHERE id=?",
                        (e.id,)
                    )
        category = vb.label if vb.label and not canonical_vendor(vb.label) else None
        entry = Entry(
            id=0, slug=slug, name=name, url=url, notes=notes, bold=bold,
            vendor_block_id=vb.id, position=position,
            section_key=section_key,
            layer_code=section.layer_code, branch_code=section.branch_code,
            vendor=canonical_vendor(vb.label or "") if vb.label else None,
            category=category, ref_nums=[ref_num],
        )
        self.repo.insert_entry(entry)
        return entry

    def remove_entry(self, slug: str):
        e = self.entry(slug)
        if not e:
            return
        self.repo.delete_entry(e.id)
        self.repo.reposition_entries(e.vendor_block_id)

    # --- render ---------------------------------------------------------

    def render(self) -> str:
        out: list[str] = []
        for s in self.sections():
            out.append(s.render())
        return "".join(out).rstrip() + "\n"

    def _render_summary_table(self) -> str:
        layers = self.repo.all_layers()
        header_branches = " | ".join(f"{c}. {n}" for c, n in MAIN_BRANCHES)
        out: list[str] = []
        out.append(f"| L | {header_branches} |")
        sep = "|---|" + "---|" * len(MAIN_BRANCHES)
        out.append(sep)
        for code, _, name in layers:
            cells_map = {b: "" for b, _ in MAIN_BRANCHES}
            for br_code, text, _marker in self.repo.all_cells_for_layer(code):
                cells_map[br_code] = text or ""
            row = f"| {code} {name} | " + " | ".join(
                cells_map[b] for b, _ in MAIN_BRANCHES) + " |"
            out.append(row)
        return "\n".join(out)

    def _render_refs_list(self) -> str:
        refs = self.repo.all_refs()
        return "\n\n".join(r.render() for r in refs)

    # --- save -----------------------------------------------------------

    def commit(self):
        self.repo.commit()

    def rebuild_derived(self):
        """Rebuild layers/branches/entries denormalized columns based on
        section_type + section.heading + entries.vendor_block."""
        conn = self.repo.conn
        # layers
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM layers")
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM branches")
        for s in self.sections():
            if s.section_type == "layer" and s.heading:
                m = LAYER_TITLE_RE.match(s.heading)
                if m:
                    self.repo.insert_layer(m.group(1), int(m.group(1)[1:]),
                                           m.group(2).strip())
        # ensure main branches present even if no section exists
        for i, (code, name) in enumerate(MAIN_BRANCHES, start=1):
            self.repo.insert_branch(code, None, i, name)
        sub_pos = 100
        for s in self.sections():
            if s.section_type in ("branch", "subbranch") and s.heading:
                m = BRANCH_TITLE_RE.match(s.heading)
                if m:
                    code = m.group(1)
                    parent = code[0] if len(code) > 1 else None
                    self.repo.insert_branch(code, parent, sub_pos,
                                            m.group(2).strip())
                    sub_pos += 1
        # update sync_meta
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_meta(key, value) VALUES (?, ?)",
            ("last_render_ts", str(int(time.time()))),
        )

# Migrator: read old `blocks` table → populate new schema

def migrate_from_blocks(conn: sqlite3.Connection):
    """One-time: read the legacy `blocks` table and populate the new
    sections / section_parts / vendor_blocks / entries / refs / cells / ...
    tables. Safe to re-run: clears new tables first."""
    cur = conn.cursor()
    # Verify legacy blocks table exists
    has_blocks = cur.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='blocks'"
    ).fetchone()
    if not has_blocks:
        sys.exit("legacy `blocks` table not found in db — nothing to migrate.")

    # Wipe new tables
    cur.executescript("""
        DELETE FROM entry_refs;
        DELETE FROM entries;
        DELETE FROM vendor_blocks;
        DELETE FROM section_parts;
        DELETE FROM refs;
        DELETE FROM cells;
        DELETE FROM sections;
        DELETE FROM layers;
        DELETE FROM branches;
    """)

    repo = Repository(conn)
    rows = cur.execute(
        "SELECT key, order_idx, block_type, title, body, layer_code, "
        "branch_code FROM blocks ORDER BY order_idx"
    ).fetchall()

    for key, order_idx, btype, title, body, layer_code, branch_code in rows:
        repo.insert_section(key, order_idx, btype, title,
                            layer_code, branch_code)

        if btype == "refs":
            # parse refs
            for line in body.split("\n"):
                m = REF_ENTRY_RE.match(line)
                if m:
                    num = int(m.group(1))
                    cit = m.group(2).strip()
                    url = m.group(3)
                    try:
                        repo.insert_ref(num, cit, url)
                    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
                        pass  # duplicate num — skip
            # part: refs_list placeholder
            repo.insert_section_part(key, 0, "refs_list", None, None)
            continue

        if btype == "summary_table":
            # split: intro prose (before table) + cells
            lines = body.split("\n")
            table_start = None
            for idx, ln in enumerate(lines):
                if ln.startswith("|"):
                    table_start = idx
                    break
            if table_start is None:
                # no table found — leave body as prose
                repo.insert_section_part(key, 0, "prose", body.rstrip(), None)
                continue
            intro = "\n".join(lines[:table_start]).rstrip()
            repo.insert_section_part(key, 0, "prose", intro, None)
            repo.insert_section_part(key, 1, "summary_table", None, None)
            # parse cells
            for ln in lines[table_start:]:
                if not ln.startswith("|"):
                    continue
                cells = [c.strip() for c in ln.strip("|").split("|")]
                if not cells or not re.match(r"^L\d{2}\b", cells[0]):
                    continue
                m = re.match(r"^(L\d{2})\s+(.+)$", cells[0])
                if not m:
                    continue
                lc = m.group(1); lname = m.group(2).strip()
                repo.insert_layer(lc, int(lc[1:]), lname)
                for i, raw_cell in enumerate(cells[1:]):
                    if i >= len(MAIN_BRANCHES):
                        break
                    bcode = MAIN_BRANCHES[i][0]
                    repo.insert_cell(lc, bcode, raw_cell,
                                     classify_cell_marker(raw_cell))
            continue

        if btype in PROSE_ONLY_TYPES:
            repo.insert_section_part(key, 0, "prose", body.rstrip(), None)
            continue

        if btype in LAYER_LIKE_TYPES:
            slug_prefix = layer_code or branch_code or key
            parser = BodyParser(slug_prefix, key, layer_code, branch_code)
            parts = parser.parse(body)
            for ppos, p in enumerate(parts):
                if p["kind"] == "prose":
                    repo.insert_section_part(key, ppos, "prose",
                                             p["prose"], None)
                else:
                    vb: VendorBlock = p["vendor_block"]
                    vb.section_key = key
                    repo.insert_vendor_block(vb)
                    repo.insert_section_part(key, ppos, "vendor_block",
                                             None, vb.id)
                    for e in vb.entries:
                        e.vendor_block_id = vb.id
                        # ensure unique slug across entire DB (not just this parser)
                        slug = e.slug
                        n = 2
                        base = slug
                        while True:
                            try:
                                repo.insert_entry(e)
                                break
                            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
                                # slug collision with another section's entry
                                slug = f"{base}-{n}"; n += 1
                                e.slug = slug
            continue

        # fallback: store body as prose
        repo.insert_section_part(key, 0, "prose", body.rstrip(), None)

    # rebuild layers/branches (and timestamp)
    doc = Document(conn)
    doc.rebuild_derived()
    conn.commit()

# db lifecycle

def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    if not DB_PATH.exists():
        sys.exit(f"db not found: {DB_PATH}; run `init` first.")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def init_db() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    conn.commit()
    return conn


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI

def cmd_init(args):
    init_db()
    print(f"initialized {DB_PATH}")


def cmd_migrate(args):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    migrate_from_blocks(conn)
    # stats
    for table in ("sections", "section_parts", "vendor_blocks",
                  "entries", "entry_refs", "refs", "cells",
                  "layers", "branches"):
        n = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table}").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"  {table:18s} {n}")
    conn.close()


def cmd_render(args):
    conn = connect()
    doc = Document(conn)
    doc.rebuild_derived()
    md = doc.render()
    MD_PATH.write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")
    doc.commit()
    print(f"rendered → {MD_PATH}  ({len(md):,} chars)")


def cmd_stats(args):
    conn = connect()
    for table in ("sections", "section_parts", "vendor_blocks",
                  "entries", "entry_refs", "refs", "cells",
                  "layers", "branches"):
        n = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table}").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"{table:18s} {n}")


def cmd_query(args):
    conn = connect()
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(args.sql).fetchall()
    except sqlite3.Error as e:
        print(f"sql error: {e}", file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
    if not rows:
        print("(no rows)"); return
    cols = rows[0].keys()
    print("\t".join(cols))
    for r in rows:
        print("\t".join("" if r[c] is None else str(r[c]) for c in cols))

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    sub.add_parser("init").set_defaults(func=cmd_init)
    sub.add_parser("migrate-from-blocks").set_defaults(func=cmd_migrate)
    sub.add_parser("render").set_defaults(func=cmd_render)
    sub.add_parser("stats").set_defaults(func=cmd_stats)

    pq = sub.add_parser("query"); pq.add_argument("sql")
    pq.set_defaults(func=cmd_query)

    # section
    ps = sub.add_parser("section")
    psub = ps.add_subparsers(dest="section_cmd", required=True)
    psub.add_parser("list").set_defaults(func=cmd_section_list)
    psh = psub.add_parser("show"); psh.add_argument("key")
    psh.set_defaults(func=cmd_section_show)
    ph = psub.add_parser("set-heading"); ph.add_argument("key")
    ph.add_argument("--heading", required=True)
    ph.set_defaults(func=cmd_section_set_heading)
    pb = psub.add_parser("set-body"); pb.add_argument("key")
    pb.add_argument("--body"); pb.add_argument("--file")
    pb.set_defaults(func=cmd_section_set_body)

    # vb
    pv = sub.add_parser("vb")
    pvsub = pv.add_subparsers(dest="vb_cmd", required=True)

from typing import Iterable

# schema

SCHEMA = """

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# constants

MAIN_BRANCHES = [
    ("A", "LLM / Agent"), ("B", "科学计算"), ("C", "机器人"),
    ("D", "自动驾驶"), ("E", "世界模型 / 3D"), ("F", "经典 CV"),
    ("G", "量化金融"), ("H", "游戏"), ("I", "影视娱乐"),
    ("J", "学习 / 教育"),
]

KNOWN_VENDORS = {
    "NVIDIA", "AMD", "Intel", "Apple", "AWS", "Google", "Microsoft", "Meta",
    "Anthropic", "OpenAI", "xAI", "DeepSeek", "Mistral", "Cohere",
    "Databricks", "Snowflake", "Cloudflare", "HuggingFace", "Hugging Face",
    "IBM", "Oracle", "SAP", "Salesforce", "ServiceNow", "Workday",
    "华为", "华为昇腾", "华为昇腾（Ascend）", "阿里", "百度", "腾讯", "字节",
    "高通", "Qualcomm", "联发科", "MediaTek", "瑞芯微", "Rockchip",
}

VENDOR_ALIASES = {
    "华为昇腾": "华为",
    "华为昇腾（Ascend）": "华为",
    "Hugging Face": "HuggingFace",
    "Qualcomm": "高通",
    "MediaTek": "联发科",
    "Rockchip": "瑞芯微",
}

PROSE_ONLY_TYPES = {"doc_top", "main_overview", "branch_intro", "branch",
                    "crosscut", "other"}
LAYER_LIKE_TYPES = {"layer", "subbranch"}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers

_PUNCT_RE = re.compile(r"[\s/（）()，,、；;:：&+]+")
_DECO_RE = re.compile(r"[*_`\"'·]")
SEP_CHARS = "、，,；;|。：:"
NAME_SPLIT_RE = re.compile(r"[" + re.escape(SEP_CHARS) + r"]|(?<=[）)\s])\+\s")
REF_LINK_RE = re.compile(r"\[\[(\d+)\]\]\((https?://[^\s)]+)\)")
REF_ENTRY_RE = re.compile(
    r"^\[(\d+)\]\s+(.+?)(?:\s*\[Online\]\.\s+Available:\s*<([^>]+)>)?\s*$"
)
LAYER_TITLE_RE = re.compile(r"^(L\d{2})\s+(.+)$")
BRANCH_TITLE_RE = re.compile(r"^([A-Z](?:\d+)?)\s+(.+)$")
VENDOR_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(r"^\*\*([^*]+)\*\*[:：]\s*$")
VENDOR_INLINE_RE = re.compile(r"^\*\*([^*]+)\*\*[:：]\s*(\S.*)$")
GROUP_LABEL_RE = re.compile(r"^([-*])\s+\*\*([^*]+)\*\*[:：]\s*(.*)$")


def canonical_vendor(label: str) -> str | None:
    plain = label.strip()
    bare = re.sub(r"（[^）]*）|\([^)]*\)", "", plain).strip()
    if plain in VENDOR_ALIASES:
        return VENDOR_ALIASES[plain]
    if bare in VENDOR_ALIASES:
        return VENDOR_ALIASES[bare]
    if plain in KNOWN_VENDORS:
        return plain
    if bare in KNOWN_VENDORS:
        return bare
    return None


def slugify(prefix: str, name: str) -> str:
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", name)
    s = _DECO_RE.sub("", s)
    s = _PUNCT_RE.sub("-", s)
    s = re.sub(r"-+", "-", s).strip("-").lower()
    if not s:
        s = hashlib.md5(name.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]
    return f"{prefix.lower()}-{s}"


def clean_name(s: str) -> str:
    s = _DECO_RE.sub("", s)
    s = re.sub(r"^[\s\-+]+|[\s\-+:：]+$", "", s)
    return s.strip()


def is_valid_name(name: str) -> bool:
    if not name:
        return False
    if name.startswith(("//", ")", "）", "/")):
        return False
    if "://" in name:
        return False
    if re.fullmatch(r"[（(].*[）)]", name):
        return False
    return True


def extract_trailing_notes(text: str, pos: int) -> str | None:
    rest = text[pos:].lstrip()
    if rest.startswith(("（", "(")):
        opener = rest[0]
        closer = "）" if opener == "（" else ")"
        depth = 0
        for i, ch in enumerate(rest):
            if ch == opener:
                depth += 1
            elif ch == closer:
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    return rest[1:i]
    return None


def classify_cell_marker(text: str) -> str:
    t = (text or "").strip()
    if not t or t in ("—", "-", "–"):
        return "none"
    if t.startswith("同 A"):
        return "same_a"
    if t.startswith("与 ") and "共用" in t:
        return "shared"
    return "normal"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# domain dataclasses (lightweight; persistence via Repository)

@dataclass
class Ref:
    num: int
    citation: str
    url: str | None

    def render(self) -> str:
        if self.url:
            return f"[{self.num}] {self.citation} [Online]. Available: <{self.url}>"
        return f"[{self.num}] {self.citation}"


@dataclass
class Entry:
    id: int
    slug: str
    name: str
    url: str | None
    notes: str | None
    bold: bool
    vendor_block_id: int
    position: int
    section_key: str
    layer_code: str | None
    branch_code: str | None
    vendor: str | None
    category: str | None
    ref_nums: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)

    def render(self) -> str:
        ref_anchor = self.ref_nums[0] if self.ref_nums else None
        ref_url = self.url or ""
        if ref_anchor is not None and ref_url:
            core = f"{self.name}[[{ref_anchor}]]({ref_url})"
        elif ref_anchor is not None:
            core = f"{self.name}[[{ref_anchor}]]()"
        else:
            core = self.name
        if self.bold:
            core = f"**{core}**"
        if self.notes:
            core += f"（{self.notes}）"
        return core


@dataclass
class VendorBlock:
    id: int
    section_key: str
    label: str | None
    vendor: str | None
    label_form: str           # 'standalone' | 'bullet_group' | 'none'
    layout: str               # 'bullets' | 'inline'
    separator: str | None     # None for bullets
    head_prose: str | None
    tail_prose: str | None
    bullet_indent: str | None
    entries: list[Entry] = field(default_factory=list)

    def render(self) -> str:
        parts: list[str] = []
        if self.layout == "bullets" and self.label_form == "standalone":
            parts.append(f"**{self.label}**：")
            if self.head_prose:
                parts.append(self.head_prose)
            for e in self.entries:
                parts.append(f"- {e.render()}")
            if self.tail_prose:
                parts.append(self.tail_prose)
            return "\n".join(parts)
        if self.layout == "inline" and self.label_form == "standalone":
            sep = self.separator or " + "
            inline = sep.join(e.render() for e in self.entries)
            head = f"**{self.label}**：{inline}"
            if self.tail_prose:
                head += self.tail_prose
            return head
        if self.label_form == "bullet_group":
            sep = self.separator or "、"
            inline = sep.join(e.render() for e in self.entries)
            indent = self.bullet_indent or "- "
            line = f"{indent}**{self.label}**：{inline}"
            if self.tail_prose:
                line += self.tail_prose
            return line
        if self.label_form == "none":
            sep = self.separator or "、"
            if self.layout == "bullets":
                return "\n".join(f"- {e.render()}" for e in self.entries)
            return sep.join(e.render() for e in self.entries)
        raise ValueError(f"unknown vendor_block render shape: "
                         f"{self.label_form}/{self.layout}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# parser: old block.body → structured parts/vendor_blocks/entries

class BodyParser:
    """Best-effort parser. For shapes we can't fully recognize we fall back
    to a 'prose' part containing the raw markdown — render then writes those
    bytes back verbatim, so no information is lost."""

    def __init__(self, slug_prefix: str, section_key: str,
                 layer_code: str | None, branch_code: str | None):
        self.prefix = slug_prefix
        self.section_key = section_key
        self.layer_code = layer_code
        self.branch_code = branch_code
        self.parts: list[dict] = []
        self.next_entry_position = 0
        self._slug_seen: set[str] = set()

    def parse(self, body: str) -> list[dict]:
        lines = body.split("\n")
        i = 0
        prose_buf: list[str] = []

        def flush_prose():
            if not prose_buf:
                return
            text = "\n".join(prose_buf).rstrip()
            # strip leading blanks but keep meaningful content
            if text.strip():
                self.parts.append({"kind": "prose", "prose": text})
            prose_buf.clear()

        while i < len(lines):
            line = lines[i]
            stripped = line.strip()

            # 1) Standalone vendor block header `**Label**：` (alone on a line)
            m = VENDOR_BLOCK_RE.match(stripped)
            if m:
                # consume label + following bullet lines (bullets layout)
                flush_prose()
                label = m.group(1).strip()
                j = i + 1
                head_prose: list[str] = []
                entries_raw: list[str] = []
                # skip blank between label and bullets
                while j < len(lines) and not lines[j].strip():
                    j += 1
                # collect contiguous bullet lines or fall back to inline
                if j < len(lines) and lines[j].lstrip().startswith(("-", "*")):
                    while j < len(lines) and lines[j].lstrip().startswith(("-", "*")):
                        entries_raw.append(lines[j])
                        j += 1
                    vb = self._make_vendor_block(
                        label=label, label_form="standalone",
                        layout="bullets", separator=None,
                        head_prose="\n".join(head_prose) or None,
                        tail_prose=None, bullet_indent=None,
                    )
                    for raw in entries_raw:
                        self._add_bullet_entry(vb, raw)
                    self.parts.append({"kind": "vendor_block",
                                       "vendor_block": vb})
                    i = j
                    continue
                # if not bullets, it's a weird shape — leave as prose
                prose_buf.append(line)
                i += 1
                continue

            # 2) Standalone inline vendor block `**Label**：content...`
            m = VENDOR_INLINE_RE.match(stripped)
            if m:
                flush_prose()
                label = m.group(1).strip()
                content = m.group(2)
                vb, _ = self._parse_inline_entries(
                    label, content, label_form="standalone",
                    bullet_indent=None,
                )
                self.parts.append({"kind": "vendor_block", "vendor_block": vb})
                i += 1
                continue

            # 3) Bullet-line `- **Label**：a、b、c` → bullet_group vb
            m = GROUP_LABEL_RE.match(line)
            if m and REF_LINK_RE.search(line):
                flush_prose()
                bullet_char = m.group(1)
                label = m.group(2).strip()
                content = m.group(3)
                # capture indent (e.g. "  - " for nested) — currently bullets
                # in this corpus are top-level, but keep the captured char
                indent = f"{bullet_char} "
                vb, _ = self._parse_inline_entries(
                    label, content, label_form="bullet_group",
                    bullet_indent=indent,
                )
                self.parts.append({"kind": "vendor_block", "vendor_block": vb})
                i += 1
                continue

            # 4) Single bullet `- **Name[[N]](url)**（notes）` (bold entry)
            #    OR `- Name[[N]](url)、Name2[[M]](url2)...` (inline list inside bullet)
            if line.lstrip().startswith(("-", "*")) and REF_LINK_RE.search(line):
                flush_prose()
                bullet_char = line.lstrip()[0]
                indent = f"{bullet_char} "
                bullet_content = line.lstrip()[1:].strip()
                # Detect single-entry bullet (whole bullet is one entry rendered)
                # vs multi-entry bullet
                vb, _ = self._parse_inline_entries(
                    label=None, content=bullet_content,
                    label_form="none", bullet_indent=indent,
                    use_layout="bullets" if self._is_single_entry(
                        bullet_content) else "inline",
                )
                self.parts.append({"kind": "vendor_block", "vendor_block": vb})
                i += 1
                continue

            # 5) Non-bullet line containing entries (no vendor label): inline list
            if REF_LINK_RE.search(line) and not line.lstrip().startswith(("-", "*", "|", "#")):
                flush_prose()
                vb, _ = self._parse_inline_entries(
                    label=None, content=line.rstrip(),
                    label_form="none", bullet_indent=None,
                    use_layout="inline",
                )
                self.parts.append({"kind": "vendor_block", "vendor_block": vb})
                i += 1
                continue

            # default: prose line
            prose_buf.append(line)
            i += 1

        flush_prose()
        return self.parts

    # -- inline parsing -------------------------------------------------

    def _is_single_entry(self, content: str) -> bool:
        """A bullet content like '**Name[[N]](url)**（notes）' represents a
        single entry. Heuristic: only one [[N]](url), and the bold wrap
        encompasses the name + ref."""
        refs = list(REF_LINK_RE.finditer(content))
        if len(refs) != 1:
            return False
        # if content is structured `**...[[N]](url)**（...）` it's single
        return bool(re.match(r"^\*\*[^*]+\*\*", content))

    def _detect_separator(self, content: str) -> str:
        """Heuristic: pick the most common entry separator in the snippet.
        Order matters — try meaningful tokens first."""
        # Look at the chars between entries
        refs = list(REF_LINK_RE.finditer(content))
        if len(refs) < 2:
            # try guess from bare name list
            if "、" in content:
                return "、"
            if " + " in content:
                return " + "
            return "、"
        seps: list[str] = []
        for k in range(len(refs) - 1):
            a_end = refs[k].end()
            # skip parenthetical notes after refs[k]
            tail = content[a_end:]
            # consume balanced notes  e.g. （...） or (...)
            note = extract_trailing_notes(content, a_end)
            if note is not None:
                # advance past the closing bracket
                stripped_tail = tail.lstrip()
                opener = stripped_tail[0]
                closer = "）" if opener == "（" else ")"
                idx = content.index(closer, a_end) + 1
                between = content[idx:refs[k+1].start()]
            else:
                between = content[a_end:refs[k+1].start()]
            between = between.split("[[", 1)[0]  # truncate at next entry-name
            # We want the separator that joins two entry tokens. Look for
            # `、` ` + ` `, ` or `; ` at the start of the gap (after consuming
            # the next entry name).
            # Easier: count occurrences of each candidate in the gap.
            for cand in ["、", " + ", "， ", ", ", " / ", "；"]:
                if cand in between:
                    seps.append(cand)
                    break
        if not seps:
            return "、"
        # most common
        return max(set(seps), key=seps.count)

    def _parse_inline_entries(
        self, label: str | None, content: str,
        label_form: str, bullet_indent: str | None,
        use_layout: str = "inline",
    ) -> tuple[VendorBlock, list[Entry]]:
        canonical = canonical_vendor(label) if label else None
        separator = self._detect_separator(content) if use_layout == "inline" else None
        vb = self._make_vendor_block(
            label=label, label_form=label_form,
            layout=use_layout, separator=separator,
            head_prose=None, tail_prose=None,
            bullet_indent=bullet_indent,
        )
        # Strip outer **...** wrapping for bold detection
        raw = content
        # Extract entries: walk REF_LINK_RE matches, name is text before each
        # match (split by NAME_SPLIT_RE). For bold-wrapped names, detect and
        # store bold=True per entry.
        entries: list[Entry] = []
        for m in REF_LINK_RE.finditer(raw):
            ref_num = int(m.group(1))
            url = m.group(2)
            before = raw[:m.start()]
            parts = NAME_SPLIT_RE.split(before)
            raw_name = parts[-1] if parts else ""
            name = clean_name(raw_name)
            bold = False
            # detect **Name** wrap by looking for unbalanced ** before
            # the match in the immediate preceding token
            tok = raw_name.strip()
            if tok.startswith("**"):
                bold = True
                name = tok.lstrip("*").strip()
            if not is_valid_name(name):
                continue
            notes = extract_trailing_notes(raw, m.end())
            entry = self._make_entry(
                vb=vb, name=name, url=url,
                notes=notes, bold=bold, ref_nums=[ref_num],
            )
            entries.append(entry)
        vb.entries = entries
        return vb, entries

    def _add_bullet_entry(self, vb: VendorBlock, raw_line: str):
        """Parse a single bullet line as one entry under a standalone vb."""
        stripped = raw_line.lstrip()
        bullet_char = stripped[0]
        content = stripped[1:].strip()
        # one bullet usually equals one entry (may have notes and multi-ref)
        # but L11 has bullets that are inline lists like `- **任务类**：a、b、c`
        # — that case is handled earlier by GROUP_LABEL_RE. Here we treat
        # the bullet as containing entries joined by the detected separator.
        sub_vb_layout = "inline" if not self._is_single_entry(content) else "bullets"
        # We're inside an existing standalone vb. For mixed cases (one bullet
        # carrying multiple inline entries), we fold them into the vb's entry
        # list with a separator note.
        for m in REF_LINK_RE.finditer(content):
            ref_num = int(m.group(1))
            url = m.group(2)
            before = content[:m.start()]
            parts = NAME_SPLIT_RE.split(before)
            raw_name = parts[-1] if parts else ""
            name = clean_name(raw_name)
            bold = False
            tok = raw_name.strip()
            if tok.startswith("**"):
                bold = True
                name = tok.lstrip("*").strip()
            if not is_valid_name(name):
                continue
            notes = extract_trailing_notes(content, m.end())
            self._make_entry(
                vb=vb, name=name, url=url, notes=notes,
                bold=bold, ref_nums=[ref_num],
            )

    # -- object factory --------------------------------------------------

    def _make_vendor_block(self, **kw) -> VendorBlock:
        return VendorBlock(
            id=0, section_key=self.section_key,
            vendor=canonical_vendor(kw.get("label", "") or ""),
            entries=[],
            **{k: kw.get(k) for k in (
                "label", "label_form", "layout", "separator",
                "head_prose", "tail_prose", "bullet_indent",
            )},
        )

    def _make_entry(self, vb: VendorBlock, name: str, url: str | None,
                    notes: str | None, bold: bool,
                    ref_nums: list[int]) -> Entry:
        slug = self._unique_slug(name)
        category = vb.label if (vb.label and not canonical_vendor(vb.label)) else None
        entry = Entry(
            id=0, slug=slug, name=name, url=url, notes=notes, bold=bold,
            vendor_block_id=0, position=self.next_entry_position,
            section_key=self.section_key,
            layer_code=self.layer_code, branch_code=self.branch_code,
            vendor=canonical_vendor(vb.label or "") if vb.label else None,
            category=category,
            ref_nums=list(ref_nums),
        )
        self.next_entry_position += 1
        vb.entries.append(entry)
        return entry

    def _unique_slug(self, name: str) -> str:
        base = slugify(self.prefix, name)
        slug = base
        n = 2
        while slug in self._slug_seen:
            slug = f"{base}-{n}"
            n += 1
        self._slug_seen.add(slug)
        return slug

# Repository

class Repository:
    """Owns the sqlite connection. Domain methods go through the model
    classes; this layer is just CRUD for them."""

    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection):
        self.conn = conn

    # --- generic helpers ------------------------------------------------

    def commit(self):
        self.conn.commit()

    # --- section CRUD ---------------------------------------------------

    def insert_section(self, key: str, position: int, section_type: str,
                       heading: str | None,
                       layer_code: str | None, branch_code: str | None):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sections(key, position, section_type, heading, "
            "layer_code, branch_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (key, position, section_type, heading, layer_code, branch_code),
        )

    def get_section_row(self, key: str):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT key, position, section_type, heading, layer_code, branch_code "
            "FROM sections WHERE key=?", (key,)
        ).fetchone()

    def update_section_heading(self, key: str, heading: str):
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE sections SET heading=? WHERE key=?",
                          (heading, key))

    def all_section_rows(self):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT key, position, section_type, heading, layer_code, branch_code "
            "FROM sections ORDER BY position"
        ).fetchall()

    # --- section_parts --------------------------------------------------

    def insert_section_part(self, section_key: str, position: int,
                            kind: str, prose: str | None,
                            vendor_block_id: int | None) -> int:
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO section_parts(section_key, position, kind, prose, "
            "vendor_block_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (section_key, position, kind, prose, vendor_block_id),
        )
        return cur.lastrowid

    def section_parts(self, section_key: str):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, position, kind, prose, vendor_block_id "
            "FROM section_parts WHERE section_key=? ORDER BY position",
            (section_key,),
        ).fetchall()

    def update_section_part_prose(self, part_id: int, prose: str):
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE section_parts SET prose=? WHERE id=?",
                          (prose, part_id))

    # --- vendor_blocks --------------------------------------------------

    def insert_vendor_block(self, vb: VendorBlock) -> int:
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO vendor_blocks(section_key, label, vendor, label_form, "
            "layout, separator, head_prose, tail_prose, bullet_indent) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (vb.section_key, vb.label, vb.vendor, vb.label_form,
             vb.layout, vb.separator, vb.head_prose, vb.tail_prose,
             vb.bullet_indent),
        )
        vb.id = cur.lastrowid
        return vb.id

    def update_vendor_block(self, vb: VendorBlock):
        self.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE vendor_blocks SET label=?, vendor=?, label_form=?, "
            "layout=?, separator=?, head_prose=?, tail_prose=?, "
            "bullet_indent=? WHERE id=?",
            (vb.label, vb.vendor, vb.label_form, vb.layout, vb.separator,
             vb.head_prose, vb.tail_prose, vb.bullet_indent, vb.id),
        )

    def load_vendor_block(self, vb_id: int) -> VendorBlock | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, section_key, label, vendor, label_form, layout, "
            "separator, head_prose, tail_prose, bullet_indent "
            "FROM vendor_blocks WHERE id=?", (vb_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return None
        vb = VendorBlock(
            id=row[0], section_key=row[1], label=row[2], vendor=row[3],
            label_form=row[4], layout=row[5], separator=row[6],
            head_prose=row[7], tail_prose=row[8], bullet_indent=row[9],
        )
        vb.entries = self.load_entries_for_vb(vb_id)
        return vb

    def vendor_blocks_for_section(self, section_key: str) -> list[VendorBlock]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM vendor_blocks WHERE section_key=?",
            (section_key,)
        ).fetchall()
        return [self.load_vendor_block(r[0]) for r in rows]

    def find_vendor_block_by_label(self, section_key: str,
                                   label: str) -> VendorBlock | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM vendor_blocks WHERE section_key=? AND label=?",
            (section_key, label)
        ).fetchone()
        return self.load_vendor_block(row[0]) if row else None

    # --- entries --------------------------------------------------------

    def insert_entry(self, e: Entry) -> int:
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO entries(slug, name, url, notes, bold, "
            "vendor_block_id, position, section_key, layer_code, "
            "branch_code, vendor, category) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (e.slug, e.name, e.url, e.notes, int(e.bold),
             e.vendor_block_id, e.position, e.section_key,
             e.layer_code, e.branch_code, e.vendor, e.category),
        )
        e.id = cur.lastrowid
        for pos, rn in enumerate(e.ref_nums):
            self.conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO entry_refs(entry_id, ref_num, position) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (e.id, rn, pos),
            )
        return e.id

    def update_entry(self, e: Entry):
        self.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE entries SET name=?, url=?, notes=?, bold=?, "
            "vendor=?, category=? WHERE id=?",
            (e.name, e.url, e.notes, int(e.bold), e.vendor, e.category, e.id),
        )

    def load_entry(self, slug: str = None, entry_id: int = None) -> Entry | None:
        if slug is not None:
            row = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, slug, name, url, notes, bold, vendor_block_id, "
                "position, section_key, layer_code, branch_code, vendor, "
                "category FROM entries WHERE slug=?", (slug,)
            ).fetchone()
        else:
            row = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, slug, name, url, notes, bold, vendor_block_id, "
                "position, section_key, layer_code, branch_code, vendor, "
                "category FROM entries WHERE id=?", (entry_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return None
        e = Entry(
            id=row[0], slug=row[1], name=row[2], url=row[3], notes=row[4],
            bold=bool(row[5]), vendor_block_id=row[6], position=row[7],
            section_key=row[8], layer_code=row[9], branch_code=row[10],
            vendor=row[11], category=row[12],
        )
        e.ref_nums = self.refs_for_entry(e.id)
        return e

    def load_entries_for_vb(self, vb_id: int) -> list[Entry]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, slug, name, url, notes, bold, vendor_block_id, "
            "position, section_key, layer_code, branch_code, vendor, "
            "category FROM entries WHERE vendor_block_id=? ORDER BY position",
            (vb_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        out = []
        for row in rows:
            e = Entry(
                id=row[0], slug=row[1], name=row[2], url=row[3], notes=row[4],
                bold=bool(row[5]), vendor_block_id=row[6], position=row[7],
                section_key=row[8], layer_code=row[9], branch_code=row[10],
                vendor=row[11], category=row[12],
            )
            e.ref_nums = self.refs_for_entry(e.id)
            out.append(e)
        return out

    def refs_for_entry(self, entry_id: int) -> list[int]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT ref_num FROM entry_refs WHERE entry_id=? ORDER BY position",
            (entry_id,)
        ).fetchall()
        return [r[0] for r in rows]

    def delete_entry(self, entry_id: int):
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM entries WHERE id=?", (entry_id,))

    def reposition_entries(self, vb_id: int):
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM entries WHERE vendor_block_id=? ORDER BY position, id",
            (vb_id,)
        ).fetchall()
        for i, (eid,) in enumerate(rows):
            self.conn.execute("UPDATE entries SET position=? WHERE id=?",
                              (i, eid))

    def set_entry_refs(self, entry_id: int, ref_nums: list[int]):
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM entry_refs WHERE entry_id=?", (entry_id,))
        for pos, rn in enumerate(ref_nums):
            self.conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO entry_refs(entry_id, ref_num, position) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (entry_id, rn, pos),
            )

    # --- refs -----------------------------------------------------------

    def insert_ref(self, num: int, citation: str, url: str | None):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO refs(num, citation, url) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (num, citation, url),
        )

    def update_ref(self, num: int, citation: str | None, url: str | None):
        fields, vals = [], []
        if citation is not None:
            fields.append("citation=?"); vals.append(citation)
        if url is not None:
            fields.append("url=?"); vals.append(url)
        if not fields:
            return
        vals.append(num)
        self.conn.execute(
            f"UPDATE refs SET {', '.join(fields)} WHERE num=?", vals,
        )

    def load_ref(self, num: int) -> Ref | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT num, citation, url FROM refs WHERE num=?", (num,)
        ).fetchone()
        return Ref(num=row[0], citation=row[1], url=row[2]) if row else None

    def all_refs(self) -> list[Ref]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT num, citation, url FROM refs ORDER BY num"
        ).fetchall()
        return [Ref(num=r[0], citation=r[1], url=r[2]) for r in rows]

    def max_ref(self) -> int:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(num), 0) FROM refs"
        ).fetchone()
        return row[0]

    def find_ref_by_url(self, url: str) -> int | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT num FROM refs WHERE url=?", (url,)
        ).fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None

    def delete_ref(self, num: int):
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM refs WHERE num=?", (num,))

    # --- cells ----------------------------------------------------------

    def insert_cell(self, layer_code: str, branch_code: str,
                    text: str | None, marker: str):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cells(layer_code, branch_code, text, marker) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (layer_code, branch_code, text, marker),
        )

    def get_cell(self, layer_code: str, branch_code: str):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT text, marker FROM cells WHERE layer_code=? AND branch_code=?",
            (layer_code, branch_code)
        ).fetchone()

    def all_cells_for_layer(self, layer_code: str) -> list[tuple]:
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT branch_code, text, marker FROM cells WHERE layer_code=?",
            (layer_code,)
        ).fetchall()

    # --- layers / branches ---------------------------------------------

    def insert_layer(self, code: str, position: int, name: str):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO layers(code, position, name) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (code, position, name),
        )

    def insert_branch(self, code: str, parent_code: str | None,
                      position: int, name: str):
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO branches(code, parent_code, position, name) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (code, parent_code, position, name),
        )

    def all_layers(self):
        return self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT code, position, name FROM layers ORDER BY position"
        ).fetchall()
